test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 27 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The difference between the compound and the simple interests for 3 years at the rate of 20% per annum is ₹432. What is the principal lent?
solution:
**Given:**

The difference between the Compound (CI) and the Simple interests (SI) is ₹432.

Time (T) = 3 years 

The Rate (R) of interest = 20% per annum

**Concept used:**

Compound Interest = P(1 + R%)T 

Simple Interest = (P × R × T)/100

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

CI - SI = Rs. 432

⇒ 432 = [P(1 + 20%)3 - 1] - [(P × 20 × 3)/100]

⇒ 432 = P[(1 + 20%)3 - 1] - P[(20 × 3)/100]

⇒ 432 = P[(1 + 0.20)3] - P[6/10]

⇒ 432 = P[(1.20)3 - 1] - P[3/5]

⇒ 432 = P[1.728 - 1 - 3/5]

⇒ 432 = P[(3.64 - 3)/5]

⇒ 432 = P[0.64/5]

⇒ P = 432/0.128

⇒ P = Rs. 3375

**∴ The principal lent was Rs. 3375.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**20% = 20/100 = 1/5

Time = 3 years

Hence assume that the Principle is 5³ = 125 Rs. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0233c5f7e079b67dd16fbfd420a805247c384a701540a6be5928465ad0501fbd.png] 

Simple Interest for 3 years = 75 Rs.

Compound Interest for 3 years = 91 Rs.

⇒ 91 - 75 = 16 

Given that, 

⇒ 16 = 432 

⇒ 1 = 432/16 

The principle, 125 

⇒ 125 × 432/16 = 3375 Rs.

 ∴ The principal lent was Rs. 3375.
